extracted.intended_audience: NAHRO members and housing practitioners interested in submitting public comments to federal agencies (e.g., HUD)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for drafting effective public comment letters to federal agencies (such as HUD), including understanding the rulemaking process, structuring the letter, legal assessment, and the procedural mechanics of submitting comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal rulemaking process
rubrics_metrics.description: The guide discusses the federal rulemaking process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understanding the rulemaking process provides context for when and how public comments are considered and the stages at which input is most effective. (Page references the Brookings guide covering this topic.)

rubrics_metrics.name: How to structure a comment letter
rubrics_metrics.description: How to structure a comment letter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on organizing a comment letter so it is clear and persuasive — presumably including recommended sections, order, and clarity of asks. (The NAHRO post highlights that the Brookings guide covers letter structure.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Things to consider about a regulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Some things to consider about a regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria for evaluating the substance of a proposed regulation (e.g., impacts, costs, benefits, practical implementation issues). The post indicates the guide outlines factors commenters should evaluate when forming their comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessing the legality of a regulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessing the legality of a regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluative standard to determine whether a rule conforms with statutory authority, constitutional constraints, or other legal requirements. The Brookings guide is noted to discuss legal assessment of regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mechanics of commenting on the rulemaking process
rubrics_metrics.description: The mechanics of commenting on the rulemaking process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural/technical requirements for submitting comments (timing/deadlines, docket numbers, submission portals/formats, confidentiality/public record considerations). The NAHRO post identifies that the guide addresses these mechanics.
